article.headline: Mavericks visit Suns Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Dallas Mavericks (11-7, eighth in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (9-8, 10th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Mavericks visit Suns Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Mavericks visit Suns Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Dallas Mavericks (11-7, eighth in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (9-8, 10th in the Western Conference) Phoenix; Friday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Dallas Mavericks travel to play the Dallas Mavericks in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Suns are 7-8 against Western Conference opponents. Phoenix has a 1-1 record in games decided by less than 4 points. The Mavericks have gone 7-5 against Western Conference opponents. Dallas is 5-4 against opponents with a winning record. The Suns are shooting 47.1% from the field this season, 0.9 percentage points higher than the 46.2% the Mavericks allow to opponents. The Mavericks are shooting 46.3% from the field, 0.2% lower than the 46.5% the Suns' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Devin Booker is averaging 24.5 points and 5.4 assists for the Suns. Jalen Green is averaging 14.5 points over the past 10 games. Kyrie Irving is scoring 21.3 points per game and averaging 3.7 rebounds for the Mavericks. Cooper Flagg is averaging 2.0 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Suns: 7-3, averaging 113.8 points, 42.2 rebounds, 27.2 assists, 7.2 steals and 3.1 blocks per game while shooting 47.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 110.6 points per game. Mavericks: 7-3, averaging 113.4 points, 43.6 rebounds, 27.6 assists, 10.1 steals and 4.9 blocks per game while shooting 45.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 111.5 points. INJURIES: Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder). Mavericks: Tobi Lawal: day to day (groin), Tarik Biberovic: out (heel), Sergio De Larrea: day to day (knee), Dereck Lively II: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
